system.description:
This Charm involves a complicated song in Old Realm. The song takes a full hour to perform, and mastering its complexities and subtleties requires a successful (Intelligence + Performance) roll at difficulty 9. Any priest may assist — including all Sidereals, as well as all Zenith, Midnight, Malefactor and No Moon Caste Exalts. Use the limited teamwork rules, with each assisting character providing a bonus success rather than an extra die.

A successful binding summons a spirit with an Essence up to three dots greater than the Sidereal's, to a maximum of Essence 7. For one season, that spirit is bound by the words to seek the joy, health and pleasure of a particular social group assigned by the Sidereal (as defined by the Mandate of Heaven system from Exalted Storyteller's Companion). The social group's Magnitude may not exceed the Sidereal's Essence x2. When that time is up, memories of who summoned and bound the spirit slip from the spirit's mind, and the spirit is free to go.
